input.quote: Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, stipulated-damages, late-payment interest or minimum/early-termination charge payable by Sparkling. Section 11 obliges Sparkling only to pay the fees set out in the Fee Schedule, and Section 17(b) permits Sparkling to terminate at will on 90 days' notice with no termination fee or remaining-value payment; searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty" and "interest" returned nothing customer-payable, and the non-solicitation covenant (Section 19) carries no placement fee. On termination for Garman's default, the money flows to us (perpetual licence, no further fees, refund of prepaid fees for services not rendered). This meets the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), so no redline is warranted.
